tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background for every screen. Body text sits on it in ink.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, reading passages, tutor bubbles and inputs that sit on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Meter tracks, the Unseen chip, code-like fields. Muted text still reads on it.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card edges. Carries no meaning on its own, so it is below 3:1 by design.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (inputs, choice buttons) on surface and surface-raised. At least 3:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and Japanese reading text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, glosses, furigana and captions on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and placeholders on surface and surface-raised. Never smaller than 12px.

tokens.name: vermilion
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary buttons, target-item marks, and the Output strand. Text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-vermilion
tokens.usage: Label color on a vermilion fill (primary button). Dark in the dark theme, because the accent lightens there.

tokens.name: vermilion-tint
tokens.usage: Soft fill behind a vermilion mark: a diagnosed error or a target word. Vermilion text reads on it.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Secondary hue: Introduced status, the Input strand, links, the meter fill and the focus ring.

tokens.name: indigo-tint
tokens.usage: Fill for the Introduced chip and the learner's own bubble. Indigo and ink text read on it.

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Learning status and the Deliberate-study strand. Text on surface, surface-raised and ochre-tint.

tokens.name: ochre-tint
tokens.usage: Fill for the Learning chip.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Known and Maintained status, correct answers, and the Fluency strand. Text on surface, surface-raised and moss-tint.

tokens.name: moss-tint
tokens.usage: Fill for the Known chip and a correct-answer note.

tokens.name: wine
tokens.usage: Leech status only. Kept apart from vermilion so a stubborn item is not read as a wrong answer.

tokens.name: wine-tint
tokens.usage: Fill for the Leech chip.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every surface. At least 3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes.

families.serif: "Shippori Mincho", "Hiragino Mincho ProN", "Yu Mincho", "Noto Serif JP", serif
families.sans: "Zen Kaku Gothic New", "Hiragino Sans", "Yu Gothic", "Noto Sans JP", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen titles and the cover. One per screen.

styles.name: reading-lg
styles.sample: 昨日、友だちと映画を見ました。
styles.usage: Graded reading passages and listening transcripts. The tall line height leaves room for furigana.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: Japanese in answers, examples, choices and tutor turns.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: English interface copy, glosses and explanations.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, strand labels, button text at small size.

styles.name: furigana
styles.usage: Ruby readings above kanji. The one place under 12px; always paired with a larger reading style.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a word and its furigana; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside buttons and bubbles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between choices.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside an activity.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between activity and its feedback.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Screen margins on wide layouts.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large vertical rhythm between sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tappable words in a passage, small marks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and passages.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips and meters.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: The word-lookup popover only. Everything else is separated by hairlines, not shadows.
